name: product-viewer
summary: Product viewer for one GLB, no build: GLTFLoader with Draco and Meshopt wired, RoomEnvironment light, soft shadow on an invisible floor, camera fitted on load, OrbitControls with damping and limits, loading and error states, colour buttons, keyboard orbit, reduced motion (no auto-rotate, no inertia)
use_for: a product page or configurator for one model
the base for material variants (KHR_materials_variants) or a GLB turntable
next: replace model.glb with your own and check it: node <threewright>/scripts/tw.mjs glb <dir>/model.glb
model.glb is made by make-model.mjs (node make-model.mjs, after npm install three@0.186.1 outside the threewright folder); rename your materials or edit VARIANTS for the colour buttons
serve the folder over http (module imports and model loads do not work from file://); ?model=missing.glb shows the error state
